pages.title: Three connected generation branches
pages.subtitle: Same G / E weights across branches · image paths and loss families only; details follow in separate tabs

l2.sub: Adversarial · CTC · writer · context · style cycle

B · REFERENCE-GUIDED TRANSFER

notes: Reference E also receives global-posterior KL and a gradient-reversed content probe; those are expanded on page 07.
The code concatenates the three branches into one batched G forward for efficiency; the separate rows show their semantics.

pages.name: 02 Alternating updates
pages.title: Who learns at each GAN step?
pages.subtitle: Current normal 32/64 configs: num_critic_train = 2 · one G/E optimizer, separate D and P optimizers

data.title: Real batch + text
data.sub: x_ref, target x, transcript y, writer w

fake.title: Generate three fake groups
fake.sub:
B/E/G forward with no_grad
random · transfer · reconstruction

upd.title: Adam step: D and P
upd.sub: G/E are not updated by this phase

objectives.title: All generator objectives
objectives.sub:
D/P + CTC + writer + L1
latent/cycle + content + context + KL

zones: A · EVERY TRAINING BATCH — UPDATE D AND P
B · EVERY SECOND CRITIC BATCH — UPDATE G AND E
notes: D/P remain differentiable with respect to generated pixels during G/E training; parameter freezing is not torch.no_grad().
B/W run in eval mode. R uses eval behavior except its recurrent block is kept in training mode for cuDNN backward support.

pages.name: 03 Global discriminator
pages.title: Whole-word adversarial learning
pages.subtitle: No patches are presented to the global D · shared D weights are repeated below to keep the loss comparisons explicit

hinge.title: Discriminator hinge loss
hinge.sub:
L_D = mean ReLU(1 − D(real))
+ mean_branches mean ReLU(1 + D(fake))

gadv.title: Global generator adversarial
gadv.sub:
L_adv = −mean_branches mean D(fake)
weight = 1.0 → updates G/E

zones: A · CRITIC UPDATE — TRAIN D ONLY
B · GENERATOR UPDATE — FREEZE D PARAMETERS, KEEP INPUT GRADIENTS
notes: D: residual CNN → optional width context → valid-area mean × 32 → scalar score. Width context is OFF in normal 32/64 configs.
Augmented real and fake whole words use the same global-D policy. Patch crops are taken from the unwarped image paths.

pages.name: 04 StrokePatchD
pages.title: Local stroke critic: sampling, comparison and network
pages.subtitle: One policy for real and all three fake branches · patch logits are supervised before spatial/crop reductions

policy.title: Stratified stroke patches
policy.sub:
side s = H/2
K = clamp(ceil(valid_width/s), 4, 8)
x: strata; y: alternate upper/lower

patchnet.title: Shared StrokePatchD P
patchnet.sub:
one spatial logit map per crop
never enters global D

blocks.title: StrokePatchBlock ×3
blocks.sub:
128 → 192 → 192; 3×3 + axial DW(1×5, 5×1)
1×1 fusion + residual; pool only when grid stays ≥4

reduce.title: Per-word reduction
reduce.sub:
map → crop → word
equal word / branch weighting

lp.title: Critic: L_P = Hinge(P(real), +1) + mean_b Hinge(P(fake_b), −1)
lp.sub: Train P; fake tensors detached. Hinge is applied per logit BEFORE spatial and crop averaging.

lgp.title: Generator: L_adv,P = −mean_b mean_word P(fake_b)
lgp.sub: Freeze P; preserve input gradients. Generator weight λ_patch_adv = 0.45.

zones: A · SHARED CROP POLICY — NO CHARACTER-ID OR DATASET-SPECIFIC RULE
B · P NETWORK — SAME STRUCTURE AT BOTH HEIGHTS
notes: Independent coordinates are drawn for each image; “same policy” does not mean pixel-aligned real/fake crops.
P receives no writer/text labels. It learns local realism from adversarial real-vs-fake supervision, not predefined stroke classes.

pages.name: 05 Random + latent recovery
pages.title: Random generation: content and global-style recovery
pages.subtitle: Train G/E · freeze B/R and both critics · local prior slots are centered; no local-token recovery loss

prior.title: Sample prior z = [z_g, z_L]
prior.sub: z_g ∼ N(0,I); z_L centered over slots

zones: A · GENERATE
B · DIFFERENTIABLE SUPERVISION
notes: z_g is a detached target in the information loss; E and G still receive gradients through the re-encoding prediction.
All losses on these pages are forward objective dependencies. Backpropagation is not drawn as a second set of reversed arrows.

pages.name: 06 Style transfer
pages.title: Reference-guided generation: which signal compares to what?
pages.subtitle: Train G/E · freeze B/W/R · W and cycle/context supervision reuse the same generated B features

wid.title: Writer CE vs w_ref
wid.sub:
λ_wid = 0.5
writer label of reference image

ctx.title: Multiscale contextual loss
ctx.sub:
fake B maps vs stop(reference B maps)
non-aligned content; bounded spatial sampling
λ_ctx = 0.1

zones: A · REFERENCE → NEW TEXT
B · FROZEN TEACHERS AND TRAINABLE GLOBAL RE-ENCODER
notes: CTC compares against y′, NOT the reference transcript y. Writer CE compares against the reference writer ID w.
The reference B pass and generated B pass supply both E and contextual features; duplicate drawing does not imply duplicate computation.

pages.name: 07 Reconstruction + disentanglement
pages.title: Exact reconstruction and reference-posterior regularization
pages.subtitle: A reconstruction target, a prior target and a content-adversary target are different signals — do not merge them

pix.sub:
x_rec versus x
valid image area only

target.sub: same sample; original x_ref and target x may differ in width

mu.title: Global posterior parameters
mu.sub:
mu_g, logvar_g
from the reference E pass

kl.title: Global KL to N(0,I)
kl.sub:
L_KL = KL(q(g|x_ref) || N(0,I)) / 8
λ_KL = 0.1; local tokens have no KL

grl.title: mu_g → gradient reversal
grl.sub: identity forward; reverse gradient to E

bce.title: Content-adversarial BCE
bce.sub:
vs bag of reference characters
BCE / 8; λ_content_adv = 0.02

bag.title: Bag of characters in y
bag.sub:
multi-hot content target
not a handcrafted character case

zones: A · IMAGE RECONSTRUCTION — SAME REFERENCE TRANSCRIPT y
B · REGULARIZE REFERENCE GLOBAL CODE — NO GENERATED IMAGE IS REQUIRED HERE
notes: Reconstruction also receives both adversarial losses (pages 03/04). Pixel weight decays 10 → 2.5 over epochs 24–42.
The probe learns to recover content; gradient reversal trains the global encoder code to hide it. No extra OCR loss is applied to x_rec.

pages.name: 08 Style encoder
pages.title: Style encoder E: separate global statistics and local evidence
pages.subtitle: B is frozen in GAN; E is trainable · 8 total style tokens (1 global + 7 local) · token dimension 32

context.title: GatedStyleContext: 2 blocks
context.sub:
DW k7, dilation 1 then 2
gated channel MLP + residual

global.title: Valid mean → LN → MLP
global.sub:
mu_g, logvar_g → reparameterize
g = mu_g + exp(0.5 logvar_g) ε

kv.title: K = visual + 2-D position
kv.sub:
V = visual − valid spatial mean
positions address evidence; not appearance

attention.title: 4-head cross-attention
attention.sub:
Q: learned queries; K/V: B evidence
bias-free local output projection

center.title: 256 → 32; center over slots
center.sub:
L_j ← L_j − mean_k L_k
7 deterministic local tokens

zones: A · GLOBAL PATH — STOCHASTIC STYLE POSTERIOR
B · LOCAL PATH — DETERMINISTIC MULTISCALE EVIDENCE
notes: Output S = [g, L1, …, L7] has shape batch × 8 × 32. Only the global posterior is sampled and KL-regularized.
global_only=True skips the local retrieval path during fake re-encoding. There is no special rule for “/”, digits, or reference text length.

pages.name: 09 Fusion + Generator
pages.title: Content-first generation with two distinct style routes
pages.subtitle: Same four-stage G at H32/H64; final-stage geometry changes with requested height, not dataset identity

ffn.title: Local gated FFN → spatial seed
ffn.sub:
DWConv1D k5; hidden width 360
linear + reshape → 512 × 4 × (4T)

bssp.title: Block-specific style projections
bssp.sub:
4 independent MLPs: 32 → 32 → 32
one vector per GBlock → CBN

refine.title: Spatial style refinement
refine.sub:
Q: spatial content features
K: LN(local); V: raw local
4 heads, width 128; learned residual

zones: A · TEXT LAYOUT — CONTENT ONLY, BEFORE STYLE REFINEMENT
B · STYLE-CONDITIONED IMAGE SYNTHESIS
notes: GBlock stages: H=8 → 16 → 32 → (32 or 64). Output width is 16T at H32 and 32T at H64; padding is not a foreground mask.
Local attention is applied ONCE after GBlock 1. No Mamba, allograph-ID gate, texture generator, or frequency loss is active here.

pages.title: Pretrain recognizer R on real labeled word images
pages.subtitle: R alone is trainable · no GAN, no writer classifier, no local-style encoder · height-matched 32/64 configurations

B · OPTIMIZATION, EVALUATION AND EXPORT
notes: When teacher_ema=false, validation/export use current online R weights directly; EMA is not a second independently trained OCR.
OCR CNN weights can initialize B for W+B pretraining. In GAN training, R is frozen and generated images are NOT inverted before R.

zones: A · WRITER CLASSIFICATION — KNOWN TRAINING WRITERS
B · LOSS, WEIGHT UPDATE AND EXPORT
notes: Default frozen_backbone=false means B IS updated. The writer checkpoint carries StyleBackbone and WriterIdentifier weights.
Writer validation uses trnval known identities; this is not an unseen-writer identification test. GAN test-writer metrics are a separate task.

pages.name: 12 Inference
pages.title: Two ways to generate handwriting — no training critics required
pages.subtitle: Inference uses G only for a prior style, or B/E/G for reference-guided style; configured GAN evaluation uses EMA G/E

e.title: Style encoder E

g=mu_g at deterministic eval

zones: A · RANDOM STYLE — NO REFERENCE IMAGE
B · STYLE TRANSFER — REFERENCE WORD CAN HAVE DIFFERENT TEXT
notes: B is loaded from the W+B checkpoint. W is unnecessary for forward generation once B is available; R and critics are training/eval tools.
Display inversion is separate from model-space tensors. Source images and fake tensors use one consistent polarity throughout the model.

target0.title: − mean D(fake); gradients through frozen D

zones: GENERATOR / ENCODER — L_G,E = SUM OF THE WEIGHTED TERMS BELOW
notes: Critic objective: L_D + L_P + lazy R1 on real whole-word D. P has no R1 term in the current training loop.
Each /8 is the explicit num_style_tokens normalization for this 8-token model. No frequency/Gram/texture-head objective is active.
